answer: Audits are written down in pulse, queued in yarrow, and karst publishes the wait time. A farm of 354 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 80 identities per epoch. A farm of 2225 identities would post 1368 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
